preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly three lines.

preconditions.expression: len(parts) == 3 and all(p.isdigit() for p in parts)
preconditions.description: The first line contains exactly three space-separated integers N, M, and K.
N, M, and K satisfy the given constraints.
The lengths of strings S and T match N and M respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in S) and all(c.islower() for c in T)
preconditions.description: Strings S and T contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a single non-negative integer.
The output integer equals the maximum number of times S can appear as a substring in a transformed string T' derived from T, where the total transformation cost does not exceed K.
